title: Version 1.34.0
body:
Version 1.34.0

August 4th, 2023

Added:

  • Secret Update Friday Content (R, ET)
  • Added weather (sunny, cloudy, rain, lightning
  • Added firefly particles around firefly jars

Changes:

  • Entrance to Skull Rock is now based off of explosive blast pressure
  • Items now take 30 minutes to despawn
  • Buffed living axe

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed fireflies not appearing
  • A new fix attempt for vehicles flinging
  • Fixed trailers/vehicles randomly respawning at a location
  • Fixed tool hit indicators locking onto the tool itself
  • More misc. bug fixes!

Version 1.34.1

August 4th, 2023

Changed:

  • Changed Electrified Tree plank color
